newsitem.title: POLAND: BRE LEADS GROUP FOR TELECOM LOAN.
newsitem.headline: BRE LEADS GROUP FOR TELECOM LOAN.

text.p: Polish Bank Rozwoju Exportu (BRE) has formed a consortium of 13 banks to lend Polish telecom giant Telekomunikacja Polska SA 200 million zlotys for investments, BRE said in a statement on Tuesday.
Among the banks in the consortium are Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy (WBK) , Polish Development Bank (PBR), Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy (BPH) and Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych (BIG) .

Also included are Westdeutsche Landesbank Polska SA, ING Bank N.V. , International Bank in Poland, PKO BP, Bank Zachodni SA, Polski Bank Inwestycyjny SA, Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy SA and Bank Energetyki SA.
